requirements_summary: Streaming suggestions delivered to agent UI with end-to-end tail latency target: 95th percentile <120ms, P99 <220ms under steady state.
Ability to sustain 500 concurrent active agents in a regional Dedicated cluster; burst to 800 with graceful fallback to cheaper variant.
Tool-calling hooks: synchronous CRM write and async workforce-management updates; must include pre-flight guardrail checks and human-in-the-loop confirmations.
Auditability: per-action audit logs retained 1 year, immutable append-only and integrated with customer SIEM via syslog/forwarder.
Privacy: PII redaction pipeline, deterministic token masking, and KMS-wrapped model keys for private deployment.
Quality: ensure suggestion accuracy on slot-filling and policy responses; Redwood Optimize eval to track regressions vs baseline prompts.
